verdict.rationale: Probes of the standard OpenAPI and Swagger paths all returned 404, and no documentation mentions a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. llms.txt, the markdown API reference, and the MCP server that exposes endpoints as tools are adjacent AI-readable docs and tooling, not a machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
